content.short: Mini Bridge by ChainEye is a lightweight cross-chain bridge optimized for small-value transfers with low fees and fast confirmation to Mantle.
content.description: Mini Bridge by ChainEye is a simple and cost-effective cross-chain bridge optimized for small-value transfers where larger bridges may have high minimum thresholds or fixed fees that make small transfers uneconomical. Designed specifically for users who need to top up gas or move modest amounts between chains, Mini Bridge supports Mantle and other popular EVM networks with minimal cost and straightforward UX.
content.meta: Mini Bridge is a low-fee cross-chain bridge optimized for small transfers to and from Mantle. Discover Mini Bridge on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
